description: This file stays at the repository root; Renovate ignores nested copies without error.
Match paths are repository-root-relative and move with their targets; a stale path selects nothing without failing.
Minor and patch updates automerge after quarantine; major and vulnerability updates require review unless a technical constraint below overrides the policy.

What the shared github>openbunny/.github preset already sets is not repeated here: dependencyDashboard, timezone, schedule, the three concurrency limits, rangeStrategy, and github-actions digest pinning. Only what differs from it or adds to it appears below.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Minor and patch automerge after quarantine and a green gate. The preset automerges only github-actions and custom.regex; this widens it to every manager.

description: One bun version lives in six places: packageManager and engines.bun in package.json,
the setup-bun bun-version input in ci.yml (twice) and canary-renewal-reminder.yml, and
both oven/bun stages in the Dockerfile. Renovate reaches them through three managers
(npm, github-actions, dockerfile) under three package names. Before this rule each one
opened its own branch against the same package.json lines, which produced the duplicate
renovate/bun and renovate/bun-1.x pair and the 'Detected empty commit' warning.
jdx/mise and oven-sh/bun reach Renovate through the github-actions manager as the
version INPUTS of jdx/mise-action and oven-sh/setup-bun, not as action refs, so the
preset's github-actions digest pinning applied to them and the lookup failed: both
projects tag releases with a prefix (v2026.9.15, bun-v1.4.2), so no git object exists
for the bare version. That was the 'Could not determine new digest for update ... did
you maybe mean the suggestedValue, with a v prefix?' dashboard warning. A digest would
say nothing here anyway: the action resolves the version against the upstream release
at run time, not against a git object pinned in this repository.
HOLDBACK: the ubuntu runner label stays on 24.04.
ubuntu-26.04 is generally available, but actionlint recognises it in no release, not
1.7.12 and not on its main branch, and reports it as unknown for every job that names
it. workflow-policy.yml runs `just actions-check`, which runs actionlint, so the move
is red with no upgrade available. Listing the label under self-hosted-runner.labels in
an actionlint.yaml would silence that only by calling a GitHub-hosted runner
self-hosted. ubuntu-24.04 is still fully supported. Same hold as openbunny/theme.
Closes when: actionlint ships a release that recognises ubuntu-26.04.
HOLDBACK HB-2026-003: TypeScript is held at 6.0.3.
typescript-eslint declares `typescript: ">=4.8.4 <6.1.0"` and refuses to load on TypeScript 7.
Closes when: typescript-eslint releases with TypeScript 7 support.
HOLDBACK HB-2026-004: ESLint is held at 9.39.5.
eslint-plugin-react calls a rule-context API that ESLint 10 removed.
Closes when: eslint-plugin-react releases compatible with ESLint 10.
HOLDBACK HB-2026-005: eslint-plugin-unicorn is held at 65.x.
66.0.0 and later declare `eslint: ">=10.4"`, and ESLint is held at 9 by HB-2026-004,
so taking unicorn alone would leave an unsatisfied peer range rather than an upgrade.
AGENTS.md section 9 documented this hold in prose before this rule enforced it.
Closes when: HB-2026-004 closes.
The bun version in vercel.json's commands. package.json needs no custom manager:
the npm manager already extracts packageManager and engines.bun, and matching them
here as well created a second dep for the same lines and a second branch for it.
mise.toml needs none either; Renovate's mise manager reads it and mise.lock.
